Title: EAC and AKU explore areas of cooperation
NewsSummary: AKU’s delegation conveys the Chancellor’s congratulatory message to Mr Mfumukeko
NewsContent:
The Secretary General of the East African Community, Amb. Liberat Mfumukeko received a delegation from the Aga Khan University led by Al-Karim Haji, Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer.

He was accompanied by Amin Kurji, Resident Representative of the Aga Khan Development Network for Tanzania and the EAC; Prof. Sharon Brownie, Dean, School of Nursing and Midwifery, and Neil Bailey, Senior Manager, Multilateral and Bilateral Relations, AKU.

The Secretary General was accompanied by his deputy Hon. Jesca Eriyo, in charge of productive and social sectors, and other senior officials from the Secretariat.

Mr Haji conveyed His Highness the Aga Khan's congratulatory message to Amb. Mfumukeko on his appointment as the Secretary General of the East African Community. His Highness assured the Secretary General of his and AKDN's continued collaboration and support and wished him a successful tenure.

The discussions that followed explored how the association between AKU and EAC in the areas of nursing and midwifery as well as media and communications could be enhanced. The EAC and AKDN have built a strong collaboration over the years. AKDN is viewed by the EAC as playing a meaningful role in social and economic development within the bloc.

As part of AKDN, AKU has had strong support from the EAC Secretariat, which has led to two grants from Germany (the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), through KfW, the German development bank) being channelled to the University via the EAC for nursing and midwifery, and media and communications studies.
